name: calyx-cbo-bridge
description: Bridge from OpenClaw to Station Calyx: get station STATE, send messages to CBO, check sponsorship, execute via spine.
author: Station Calyx

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Fetch Station Calyx STATE (STATE.md). Use when the user asks for station status, health, services, or what the station is doing. Returns the full state document.

tools.name: send_to_cbo
tools.description: Send a message to CBO Core and get a reply. Use when the user wants to run a command through Station Calyx, ask CBO something, or get a response from the station. Prefer workhorse model for speed unless the user asks for architect or local.

message.description: The user message or command to send to CBO

model_role.description: Optional: workhorse (default), architect, second_opinion, or local

tools.name: sponsorship
tools.description: Check if CBO sponsorship is in effect (Architect-signed Calyx Sign). Use when the user asks about sponsorship status or permission to stamp operations.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Route execution through spine (Mail → Intent → Work Envelope → Contract Gate). Use for spine-routed tasks (doc_update, etc.) when the user wants a specific task type executed via governance.
